# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Trees of Life and the Inheritance of Hades

---

**13:1** Do not scorn us, O God, when we cry out in our anguish —
when affliction and misery have brought us low.

**13:2** The right hand of the LORD is our shield;
the hand of the LORD is over us for good.

**13:3** The LORD disciplines the devout with a loving rod;
he guides them into the life that God himself lives.

**13:4** The devout of the LORD live by that guidance forever;
they are the trees of life in the LORD's own Paradise.

**13:5** Their roots are planted and will never be pulled out —
not for all the ages of heaven.

**13:6** For Israel is the portion and inheritance of God.

**13:7** But not so for sinners and transgressors —
those who love nothing but the brief season of their sinful pleasure;

**13:8** their delight is in passing corruption,
and God never enters their thoughts.

**13:9** For the ways of men lie open before the LORD;
he knows what the heart holds before any thought arises.

**13:10** Therefore their inheritance is Hades, darkness, and ruin —
they will not be found when the day comes that the righteous receive mercy.

**13:11** But the devout of the LORD will inherit life in joy!

**13:12** Our life is in the love of God forever;
we put our hope in him for all eternity.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
